title: Argininyl-Fructosyl-Galactose: A Novel Amino Acid Derivative Improves Cisplatin-induced Intestinal Toxicity via Reactive Oxygen Species-mediated Apoptosis Pathway.
authors: Liu, Wei; Zheng, Yi-Nan; Jiang, Shuang; Ren, Shen; Tang, Shan; Zhang, Jing; Wang, Zi; Li, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究红参来源氨基酸衍生物AFGA对顺铂肠毒性的保护作用，涉及氧化应激和凋亡通路，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Based on the Maillard reaction principle of red ginseng, this study innovatively synthesized a new amino acid derivative by combining arginine with lactose through simulated synthesis and was separated and purified through repeated silica gel and polyacrylamide gel (Bio-gel P-II) column chromatography. PURPOSE: The work was aimed at elucidating the synthesis of a novel amino acid derivative and investigating the intestinal protective activity of the novel amino acid derivative and possible molecular mechanism by establishing the intestinal injury model induced by cisplatin in mice. METHODS: The purity and molecular weight of the amino acid derivatives were determined to be by electrospray ionization mass spectrometry (ESI-MS). Subsequently, by establishing cisplatin (20 mg/kg)-induced intestinal injury in vivo for 10 days and IEC-6 cell model. The biochemical indexes and histopathological analysis were used to evaluate the oxidative stress and inflammatory and pathological changes of intestinal tissue in mice. The protein expression levels of p-Nuclear transcription factor-kappaB (p-NF-kappaB), cleaved caspase 3/caspase 3, cleaved caspase 9/caspase-9, Bcl-2, Bax, cytochrome C, phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase (PI3K), Protein Kinase B (Akt), p-PI3K, p-Akt were quantified through immunofluorescence staining and western blot analysis. RESULTS: The new amino acid derivatives of chemical structure were identified to be 1- (arginine-N(alpha)group)-1-deoxy-4-O-(beta-D-galactopyranosyl)-D-fructose, named Argininylfructosyl- galactose (AFGA, C(18)H(34)N(4)O(12)). The results showed that pretreatment with a single AFGA dose remarkably alleviated cisplatin-evoked intestinal oxidative stress injury, and the levels of reactive oxygen species (ROS) were lessening in IEC-6 cells (p<0.05, p<0.01) and could effectively reduce the secretion of TNF-alpha and IL-1beta in serum and the expression level of NF-kappaB protein in intestinal tissues (p<0.01). Meantime, AFGA also significantly suppressed the caspase 3, caspase 9, cytochrome C and Bax protein expression in intestinal tissue in mice (p<0.01), and regulated the PI3K/Akt pathway (p<0.05, p<0.01). Importantly, the molecular docking results of AFGA also suggested a better binding ability with the above-mentioned related target proteins. CONCLUSION: The results clearly revealed AFGA as a potential multifunctional therapeutic agent with a clear protective effect against cisplatin-induced intestinal injury may be related to the PI3K/Akt signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 背景：基于红参的美拉德反应原理，本研究通过模拟合成将精氨酸与乳糖结合，创新性地合成了一种新的氨基酸衍生物，并通过反复硅胶和聚丙烯酰胺凝胶（Bio-gel P-II）柱色谱法进行分离纯化。目的：本研究旨在阐明一种新型氨基酸衍生物的合成，并通过建立顺铂诱导的小鼠肠道损伤模型，探讨该新型氨基酸衍生物的肠道保护活性及其可能的分子机制。方法：通过电喷雾电离质谱（ESI-MS）测定氨基酸衍生物的纯度和分子量。随后，建立顺铂（20 mg/kg）诱导的体内肠道损伤模型，持续10天，以及IEC-6细胞模型。采用生化指标和组织病理学分析评估小鼠肠道组织的氧化应激、炎症及病理变化。通过免疫荧光染色和蛋白质印迹分析定量p-核转录因子-κB（p-NF-κB）、cleaved caspase 3/caspase 3、cleaved caspase 9/caspase-9、Bcl-2、Bax、细胞色素C、磷脂酰肌醇3-激酶（PI3K）、蛋白激酶B（Akt）、p-PI3K、p-Akt的蛋白表达水平。结果：新型氨基酸衍生物的化学结构被鉴定为1-（精氨酸-N(α)基）-1-脱氧-4-O-（β-D-半乳糖吡喃糖基）-D-果糖，命名为精氨酰果糖基-半乳糖（AFGA，C(18)H(34)N(4)O(12)）。结果表明，单剂量AFGA预处理显著缓解了顺铂引起的肠道氧化应激损伤，IEC-6细胞中活性氧（ROS）水平降低（p<0.05，p<0.01），并能有效减少血清中TNF-α和IL-1β的分泌以及肠道组织中NF-κB蛋白的表达水平（p<0.01）。同时，AFGA还显著抑制了小鼠肠道组织中caspase 3、caspase 9、细胞色素C和Bax蛋白的表达（p<0.01），并调节了PI3K/Akt通路（p<0.05，p<0.01）。重要的是，AFGA的分子对接结果也表明其与上述相关靶蛋白具有较好的结合能力。结论：结果明确显示，AFGA作为一种潜在的多功能治疗剂，对顺铂诱导的肠道损伤具有显著保护作用，这可能与PI3K/Akt信号通路有关。
